kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
احتضروا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَضَرُوا (iḥtaḍarū) /iħ.ta.dˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# اُحْتُضِرُوا (uḥtuḍirū) /uħ.tu.dˤi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
# اِحْتَضِرُوا (iḥtaḍirū) /iħ.ta.dˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
